description: Import an external plugin. Without `plugin` into a new plugin, with `slug` and `name` or the proposed ones (nothing is regenerated); a package with several plugins needs `pick`. With `plugin` (its exact name, or its id with `pluginById`) it is merged into that plugin: without `decisions` (safe mode) every new item is added, nothing is replaced and the rules are kept; `decisions` is the merge preview's shape (`previewId`, `sourceFingerprint`, `fingerprint`, per kind `add`/`replace` of `{name}` items, `confirmReplace`, `rules` keep | append | replace for the external plugin's AGENTS.md). The plugin records the external plugin as a source (plugins_external_sources) for later updates. `source` is a public GitHub or GitLab repository URL (a tree URL picks a ref and a sub-folder), or the path of a local external plugin folder, resolved against the project root, which is zipped (without .git, node_modules and links) and uploaded. Formats: Agent Plugins (`plugin.json`), Claude Code plugins (`.claude-plugin/plugin.json`), marketplaces and `plugins/*` folders; skills, agents, MCP servers and the root `AGENTS.md` (as the rules) are imported, hooks, commands and the like are listed as ignored. A `slug` is refused, writing nothing, with code `plugin_slug_conflict` (409: another plugin of the project has it), `plugin_slug_forbidden` (a reserved slug), `plugin_slug_locked` (the slug of this plugin cannot be changed) or `plugin_slug_invalid` (not a valid slug). When `plugin` is the installed plugin, it is then regenerated locally, like `athenode init` without confirmation (the result adds `install` and `regeneration`); if that fails, the backend change is still saved and the tool returns an error. Any other plugin is changed on the server only.

decisions.description: Decisions of a merge into `plugin`: {previewId?, sourceFingerprint, fingerprint, confirmReplace?, skills?, agents?, mcpServers?, rules?} (CLI: --decisions). Safe mode if omitted.

name.description: The new plugin's name, at most 200 characters.

pick.description: The external plugin to import of a package that offers several (a marketplace or a plugins/ folder) (CLI: --pick).

plugin.description: Name of the plugin, or its id with pluginById (CLI: --plugin).

pluginById.description: `plugin` is a plugin id, not a name (CLI: --plugin-by-id).

slug.description: The new plugin's slug (CLI: --slug). Unique in the project; it is the name of the plugin package and the prefix of its commands.

source.description: Repository URL, or the path of a local external plugin folder.

name: plugins_external_import
title: Import external plugin
